premise: Hedgehog cannot sleep; Owl says count stars, Snail says count slow steps, Mushroom says count breaths; Hedgehog counts his own prickles and is snoring by six.
inspiration: Counting-sheep lullaby pattern, turned: three friends offer three ways to count, and the one that works is the one he carries with him.
lesson: When you can't sleep, count something slow and close.

en-US.title: Hedgehog Counts to Sleep
en-US.text: It was late and Hedgehog could not sleep. He {hedgehog:wobble x2} rolled this way. He rolled that way. Hmph. Owl {owl:pulse} looked down from his branch. Count the stars, said Owl. So Hedgehog looked up. One. Two. Three. Four... there were far too many. Hmph. Snail {snail:pulse} slid by. Count my steps, said Snail. So Hedgehog counted. One... two... they were so slow that Hedgehog got fidgety in between. Hmph. Count your breaths, said Mushroom {mushroom:glow 0.4} softly from the moss. In, one. Out, two. Hedgehog tried. In, one. Out, two. In, three. That was better. Hedgehog curled up in a ball. And there, right in front of his nose, were his own prickles. Oh, he thought. He counted one. {hedgehog:pulse 0.3} Two. Three. Four. Fi... {hedgehog:fade-out 2s hold} Zzz. Owl smiled. {owl:glow hold} Snail smiled. Mushroom glowed like a night-light. Good night, Hedgehog. Six.

es-ES.title: Erizo cuenta para dormir
es-ES.text: Era tarde y Erizo no podía dormir. {hedgehog:wobble x2} Se dio la vuelta para un lado. Se dio la vuelta para el otro. Uf. Búho {owl:pulse} lo miró desde su rama. Cuenta las estrellas, dijo Búho. Erizo miró hacia arriba. Una. Dos. Tres. Cuatro... había demasiadas. Uf. Caracol {snail:pulse} pasó deslizándose. Cuenta mis pasos, dijo Caracol. Erizo contó. Uno... dos... eran tan lentos que a Erizo le entraba el hormigueo entre uno y otro. Uf. Cuenta tus respiraciones, dijo Seta {mushroom:glow 0.4} bajito desde el musgo. Dentro, uno. Fuera, dos. Erizo probó. Dentro, uno. Fuera, dos. Dentro, tres. Eso iba mejor. Erizo se hizo una bola. Y allí, justo delante de su nariz, estaban sus propios pinchos. Anda, pensó. Contó uno. {hedgehog:pulse 0.3} Dos. Tres. Cuatro. Cin... {hedgehog:fade-out 2s hold} Zzz. Búho sonrió. {owl:glow hold} Caracol sonrió. Seta brilló como una lamparita. Buenas noches, Erizo. Seis.
